name: Server Manager
description: Remote server management for Joinery instances
author: Joinery

settings.name: server_manager_provisioning_admin_alert_email
settings.label: Provisioning alert email
settings.helptext: Who to tell when a customer provisioning job needs attention.

settings.name: server_manager_provisioning_domain_question_id
settings.label: Domain question id
settings.helptext: The purchase question whose answer supplies the customer's domain.

settings.name: server_manager_cert_expiry_warn_days
settings.label: Warn this many days before a certificate expires

settings.name: server_manager_linode_referral_url
settings.helptext: Linode referral URL shown on the Connect page's create-account link. New accounts signed up through it receive Linode's referral credit.
settings.label: Linode referral URL

settings.name: server_manager_customer_cloud_region
settings.helptext: Default region for customer-cloud instances.
settings.label: Customer cloud region

settings.name: server_manager_customer_cloud_type
settings.helptext: Default instance type for customer-cloud instances.
settings.label: Customer cloud instance type

settings.name: server_manager_customer_cloud_image
settings.helptext: OS image for customer-cloud instances. Must be an Ubuntu LTS the installer supports (26.04 or 24.04).
settings.label: Customer cloud image

settings.name: server_manager_upgrade_retention_count
settings.helptext: How many recent core upgrade archives to keep on disk. Older archives are removed after each publish; their release-history records are always kept. Archives marked Keep, and any version a managed node is running, are never removed. Set to 0 to keep every archive.
settings.label: Upgrade archives to keep

settings.name: server_manager_agent_source_path
settings.helptext: Path to the joinery-agent source checkout on this management node. When set (or when the default /home/user1/joinery-agent exists), publishing a release rebuilds and signs the bundled agent artifact; otherwise the previously bundled artifact carries forward.
settings.label: Agent source path

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_enabled
settings.label: Back up newly managed nodes by default
settings.helptext: Whether a node this management node manages gets backed up here unless someone says otherwise. On by default, and that default is what stops a new node being forgotten. A site's own backups are separate and unaffected either way.

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_window_start
settings.label: Backup window starts (UTC)
settings.helptext: The earliest a fleet backup begins. Each node gets its own minute inside the window, derived from its name, so they do not all start at once.

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_window_minutes
settings.label: Backup window length (minutes)
settings.helptext: How wide to spread node start times. Wider means fewer simultaneous uploads and a longer tail; 120 suits a few dozen nodes.

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_mode
settings.label: How fleet backups are taken
settings.helptext: Incremental chains send only what changed after the first run — measured at 193 MB then 37 kB — which across a fleet is most of the bandwidth. A full every time makes each restore point self-contained at much greater cost.

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_keep
settings.label: Restore points kept per node
settings.helptext: How many backups to keep on this management node's shelf for each node. Chains are kept or deleted whole, never partly.

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_full_interval_days
settings.label: Days before a chain starts a fresh full
settings.helptext: How long one chain runs before the next backup starts over with a full. Shorter means more storage and shorter restore chains.

settings.name: server_manager_fleet_backup_max_concurrent
settings.label: Backups running at once across the fleet
settings.helptext: A ceiling on simultaneous fleet backups. Nodes over the limit wait for the next tick rather than queueing.

settings.name: server_manager_namecheap_api_user
settings.label: Namecheap API user
settings.helptext: The Namecheap account username the API calls are made as.

settings.name: server_manager_namecheap_api_key
settings.label: Namecheap API key
settings.helptext: Set this on the Provisioning Setup page, which seals it at rest.

settings.name: server_manager_namecheap_client_ip
settings.label: Allowlisted client IP
settings.helptext: The management node's egress IP, allowlisted in the Namecheap API panel.

settings.name: server_manager_namecheap_sandbox
settings.label: Use Namecheap sandbox
settings.helptext: Point registrar calls at Namecheap's sandbox. Names bought there are not real.

settings.name: server_manager_domain_tlds
settings.label: Offered TLDs
settings.helptext: Space-separated. A domain outside these endings is refused at checkout.

settings.name: server_manager_domain_orphan_swept_id
settings.helptext: High-water mark over order items already checked for a paid domain year that produced no registration. Written by ManagedDomainWatch so each such order is reported once.

sealed_secrets.label: Clone export key armed on a provision's source
